name: Triveni Turbine Ltd
tagline: High-quality steam turbine maker with a real Q1FY27 margin miss and an emerging, unproven US AI-data-center demand catalyst
business_overview: Triveni Turbine manufactures sub-100MW steam turbines with a growing high-margin aftermarket business (33%+ of sales) and export operations. Recently signed a large (Rs 400 Cr) order in Guyana and is pursuing a CO2 mechanical-storage technology-validation project with NTPC.
fundamentals_narrative: Strong historical quality metrics (27%+ ROE, debt-free, real profit CAGR), with Q4 FY25 marking the highest-ever revenue/EBITDA/PAT in company history. However, Q1 FY27 (most recent quarter) showed a sharp EBITDA margin drop to 18.0% from 25.8% YoY and a 35.4% slowdown in domestic order bookings — a real, live deterioration management attributes to temporary, deliberate factors rather than a structural issue.
sentiment_summary: Read most recent posts from the entire thread (42 posts, single batch, focused on 2024-2026 where the current-cycle debate lives). A genuinely active, analytically detailed thread (kdjolly's earnings-call summaries are notably thorough) tracking a real inflection between historical strength and a fresh, unresolved margin question.
community_signal: Trusted-roster users Chandragupta (29 loves/4 posts, informational tracking since 2022, no explicit conviction/position-size statement) and karanshah137 (2 loves, a single neutral comment on UK FTA impact) both posted but neither logged as a high-conviction call. kdjolly provided the most detailed recent synthesis: management's Q1 FY27 counter-narrative attributes the margin miss to a deliberate near-zero-margin NTPC CO2-storage technology-validation project plus client-driven export dispatch delays from a 3-4x ocean freight spike — with high-margin export order inflows (+53.4% YoY) and aftermarket backlog (+115.1% YoY) cited as evidence of an imminent H2 FY27 recovery. Management also flagged a ~3 GW enquiry pipeline for combined-cycle steam turbines tied to the US AI/data-center power boom, though conversion cycles remain extended and unproven.
bull_case: Strong multi-year quality track record — 27%+ ROE, debt-free, real profit growth, and a genuinely growing high-margin aftermarket business

Management's explanation for the Q1 FY27 margin miss is specific and falsifiable (a named, low-margin technology-validation project plus freight-driven export delays) rather than vague — high-margin export orders (+53.4% YoY) and aftermarket backlog (+115.1% YoY) provide leading evidence the recovery narrative may hold
The US AI/data-center power boom is a genuinely large, differentiated emerging demand driver (~3 GW enquiry book) that didn't exist as a thesis pillar a few years ago
bear_case: The Q1 FY27 margin miss (18.0% vs 25.8% YoY) and 35.4% domestic order-booking slowdown are real, current, and not yet resolved — management's 'temporary' explanation hasn't been proven out by results yet

At Rs 18,109 Cr market cap, the size requires a large, durable catalyst to clear this screen's asymmetric-upside bar — the US data-center opportunity is still an 'enquiry book' with 'extended conversion cycles,' not booked orders
Domestic order booking has shown a declining trend since at least early 2025, predating this quarter's miss
US water-permitting reality (referenced but not detailed in the excerpt read) was flagged by analysts as a potential constraint on the data-center opportunity's actual conversion
verdict_headline: Quality compounder at an unresolved inflection point — real near-term margin risk against a genuinely interesting emerging catalyst
verdict_reasoning: Historical fundamentals are excellent, but the most recent quarter's margin miss and order-booking slowdown are live, unresolved risks, not yet validated by subsequent results
The AI/data-center demand catalyst is specific and differentiated but still pre-conversion (enquiry stage) — not yet the kind of dated, concrete catalyst this screen requires at this market cap
Worth a near-term revisit once H2 FY27 results test management's margin-recovery narrative

four_box.note: US AI/data-center power boom (~3GW enquiry book) is a genuinely differentiated new demand driver; still pre-conversion ('enquiry book' with extended cycles), not booked orders, at a Rs18,109cr size — tam weak; growing high-margin aftermarket + export orders (+53.4% YoY) is a real but undetailed edge — moat weak; Q1 FY27 margin miss (18.0% vs 25.8% YoY) and a 35.4% domestic order-booking slowdown are live, unresolved — valuation no.
